scientific_question: Can a capacity-matched learned temporal mismatch statistic trained on two tail perturbations recognize a disjoint, never-trained family without relying on identical positives?
hypothesis: Circular anchor-relative pooled mismatch should transfer to an unseen even-odd interleave, while raw per-position weights may overfit training perturbations and unordered histogram cannot detect order.
freeze: This preregistration must be committed before scientific code's first experiment invocation and CI. No parameters, splits, feature maps, thresholds, scores, labels or training budget changed afterward.
population: Same original 16-step W-R11/W-R12 four-channel synthetic generator, but fresh seeds 8 through 15. Every second sequence has a shared nuisance channel offset; negative order changes preserve the candidate multiset and anchor.
training_perturbation: For each development seed/entity, negative uses tail reverse for even entity and tail rotate left by 3 for odd entity. Positive preserves order. Nuisance +17 on all four channels for both negative and positive candidate.
heldout_perturbation: Nuisance +47 and new even-index-first/odd-index-last weave of 15-element tail (indices [0,2,...14,1,3,...13]) on negative candidate. Never included in training. Positive candidate retains order.
arms: anchor-relative unordered modulo16 histogram difference, 16 features
same mean absolute anchor-relative circular mismatch repeated across 16 feature dimensions; no extra model parameters
learning: Exactly 16 weights plus bias per arm, zero initialization, learning-rate .1, 32 full ordered epochs, 72 examples; perceptron updates only at signed margin<=0. No validation examples included in training.
primary: Report per-seed TP/TN/FP/FN and heldout accuracy on sealed seeds. TRANSFER if pooled >=0.85 and histogram <=0.55; PARTIAL if pooled > histogram but <0.85; NEGATIVE otherwise. Zero positives or negatives rejected as invalid.
critical_controls: All candidates' positive and negative pairs have the same anchor/multiset; channel offset differs from training to heldout; verify invariant features; independent deterministic replay; full repo regression; source identities.
claim_limit: Narrow synthetic supervised perturbation recognition, not natural language understanding, raw reasoning, semantic transfer, or accepted-ref promotion.
